tools.name: aegis_scan
tools.description: Run AEGIS security scan on a project directory. Read-only: reads source files + runs configured scanners + returns the score, grade, and top-20 findings. Caches the full result for subsequent aegis_findings / aegis_fix_suggestion calls.

path.description: Absolute path to the project directory to scan

mode.description: scan = fast (security, deps, quality, compliance, i18n); audit = all scanners

tools.name: aegis_findings
tools.description: Get detailed findings from the last scan, optionally filtered by severity, scanner, or file. Requires a prior aegis_scan call — returns empty findings when no scan has run yet.

severity.description: Filter to a specific severity level

scanner.description: Filter to a specific scanner name

file.description: Filter to findings in a specific file (suffix-match on relative path, e.g. "src/api/x.ts")

limit.description: Maximum number of findings to return (default: 100)

tools.name: aegis_score
tools.description: Get the current AEGIS security score (0-1000 with FORTRESS → CRITICAL grade) for a project. Runs a full scan on every call (no caching yet — repeated calls re-scan from scratch).

path.description: Absolute path to the project directory

tools.name: aegis_compliance
tools.description: Check compliance against a specific framework (gdpr / soc2 / iso27001 / pci-dss). Runs a full audit scan and filters to compliance-category findings.

path.description: Absolute path to the project directory

framework.description: Compliance framework to check against — one of gdpr, soc2, iso27001, pci-dss

tools.name: aegis_fix_suggestion
tools.description: Get a fix suggestion for a specific finding from the last scan. Requires a prior aegis_scan call — returns found=false when no scan has run yet OR when the findingId is not present in the cached result.

findingId.description: The ID of the finding (from aegis_scan or aegis_findings)
